title: Turning the Sun Into a Giant Telescope with Dr. Slava Turyshev
summary: Fraser Cain interviews JPL physicist Slava Turyshev about using the Sun's gravity as a lens to image distant exoplanets. They cover how the lens works, how a spacecraft would align with it, and mission design.
why: HN points to it as the best accessible explanation of the solar gravitational lens mission plan.

quote.text: It is the most interesting interview that I have seen in years, possibly ever.
